name: omp-actual-terminal
description: Long-lived PTY terminals for omp: send input with write_stdin, read terminal state via term://, and await events or completion with monitor. Full raw output logged to disk.
author: Ren Wang <iamwrm@gmail.com>

notice.graceReclaim.description: Send a reclaimed notice when a read terminal is reclaimed after its reclaim-due grace

exec.initFile.description: POSIX shell script every bash pty: true terminal's shell sources before its command, e.g. export NAME=value or alias omp='omp --hide-thinking'. Use ~/ or an absolute path; a project's .omp/plugin-overrides.json value replaces it, relative paths there resolve against the session cwd

stop.description: How omp-actual-terminal decides whether a stopped agent finished its task before delivering pending notices

judgePrompt.description: Prompt template for the stop judge and @smol detector. Placeholders: {last_response}, {notices}, {todo}

noticeTemplate.description: Template for delivered terminal notice messages. Placeholders: {summary}, {items}, {instruction}, {terminal_count}, {notice_count}
